literal: Nature having known, oneself having made, oneself if protecting, will perish among enemies arisen pride.
translation: If one understands the nature of things, strengthens oneself, and guards oneself well, the pride that has arisen in one's enemies will perish.
modern: சூழ்நிலைகளின் தன்மையை அறிந்து, தன்னை வலிமைப்படுத்திக் கொண்டு, தன்னைத் தற்காத்துக் கொண்டால், பகைவர்களிடம் உண்டான செருக்கு அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how to defeat the arrogance of foes through careful preparation. The word 'வகை' (nature or categories) refers to understanding the various aspects of strength and weakness in a given conflict. 'தற்செய்து' means building up one's own power and resources, while 'தற்காப்ப' emphasizes the need for vigilant self-defense. When one is fully prepared and protected, the 'செருக்கு' (pride or overconfidence) that has arisen in the enemies will naturally 'மாயும்' (perish), as they realize their opponent cannot be easily defeated.
